content.short: Ditto Quest is a multi-faceted TON game involving farming, crafting, and battling with digital creatures.
content.description: Ditto Quest is a rich and expansive decentralized gaming project on the TON blockchain that blends multiple popular genres, including farming, crafting, and creature battling. Players can develop their virtual homesteads, gather resources to craft valuable items, and engage in competitive battles with their digital 'Dittos.' Every major asset is recorded as an NFT, ensuring true ownership for participants. Ditto Quest provides a deep and varied Play-to-Earn experience, encouraging long-term engagement and strategic play within the vibrant TON gaming community.
content.meta: Farm, craft, and battle in Ditto Quest on TON. Immersive Web3 gaming on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
